findings.title: getCredential only checks federated credentials, missing credentials from custom UserStorageProviders
findings.body: `RecoveryAuthnCodesUtils.getCredential(user)` calls `user.credentialManager().getFederatedCredentialsStream()` and falls back to `getStoredCredentialsByTypeStream(RecoveryAuthnCodesCredentialModel.TYPE)`. However, `getFederatedCredentialsStream()` only queries `session.userFederatedStorage().getStoredCredentialsStream(...)` and does NOT invoke `CredentialInputUpdater.getCredentials(realm, user)` on the user's `UserStorageProvider`. In contrast, `getStoredCredentialsByTypeStream` (on `UserCredentialManager`) already combines local DB storage, federated storage, and `UserStorageProvider` credentials (when the provider implements `getCredentials` or when dummy representations are generated). Furthermore, if a `UserStorageProvider` does not override `CredentialInputUpdater.getCredentials(...)`, `UserCredentialManager` creates a dummy `CredentialModel` (via `CredentialHelper.createUserStorageCredentialRepresentation`) that has null `credentialData`/`secretData`; passing that to `RecoveryAuthnCodesCredentialModel.createFromCredentialModel(...)` in `RecoveryAuthnCodeInputLoginBean` (line 19) or `RecoveryAuthnCodesFormAuthenticator` (line 83) will throw a `RuntimeException` / `NullPointerException` when parsing the JSON data.

findings.title: BackwardsCompatibilityUserStorage modified with APIs that did not exist in Keycloak 4.8.3
findings.body: The class javadoc explicitly states: "UserStorage implementation created in Keycloak 4.8.3. It is used for backwards compatibility testing. Future Keycloak versions should work fine without a need to change the code of this provider." This change adds `RecoveryAuthnCodesCredentialModel` and `CredentialInputUpdater.getCredentials(RealmModel, UserModel)` (lines 46, 231) to `BackwardsCompatibilityUserStorage`, neither of which existed in Keycloak 4.8.3. Relying on `getCredentials` in this provider also masks what happens with an actual 4.8.3-style `UserStorageProvider` that only implements `supportsCredentialType`, `updateCredential`, `isConfiguredFor`, and `isValid` without overriding the default `getCredentials` method.
